stories.title: Aurora City Council passes moratorium as Vantage drops proposed Trident data center site
stories.summary: Vantage Data Centers told 9NEWS it will no longer pursue its proposed site off 48th Avenue in Aurora and is still looking for alternatives.

stories.title: 2 in custody after hours long standoff on Douglas County roadway
stories.summary: Deputies pinned a vehicle, which had stolen plates, on Lincoln Avenue near Oswego Street. The two people inside refused to exit, the sheriff's office said.

stories.title: Denver sets aside $40M in downtown funds to help land 2028 Democratic National Convention
stories.summary: The money comes from property and sales taxes at Union Station.

stories.title: 86-year-old 'Cradle Lady' builds 105 wooden cradles for Denver Santa Claus Shop
stories.summary: Lillian Glasgow, known as the "Cradle Lady," has dedicated 54 years to crafting wooden cradles for the Denver Santa Claus Shop.

stories.title: 'We're in a crisis:' Colorado's childcare assistance program faces mounting financial pressure
stories.summary: More than 10,000 fewer children are receiving state child care assistance than two years ago, with no immediate funding solution in sight.

stories.title: Denver cloudy, chilly Monday with light mountain snow
stories.summary: A Winter Weather Advisory is posted for the mountains for light snow Monday. Warmer, drier weather returns midweek ahead of the next storm arriving Friday

stories.title: Weld Food Bank serving 5 times as many people as 6 years ago as demand continues to grow
stories.summary: The food bank is spending more than $4 million annually purchasing food, but families are receiving less as the organization struggles to keep up with demand.

stories.title: Denver street remains closed after 2nd water main break
stories.summary: South Holly Street between East Evans and East Iliff Avenues is closed as Denver Water fixes a broken cast iron water main and the road.

stories.title: Denver study finds crashes down more than 50% after controversial safety changes to Sloans Lake road
stories.summary: A controversial redesign of West 29th Avenue in Denver shows promising safety results.

stories.title: Denver officer being sued over wrongful package theft detention was previously suspended in domestic violence case
stories.summary: A Denver Police officer sued for wrongfully detaining a woman over a missing package was previously suspended for mishandling a domestic violence call.

stories.title: New deck of cards puts Fort Collins art in your hands
stories.summary: A new deck of playing cards is bringing 54 Fort Collins-area artists together, turning local artwork into something people can take home, share and play with.

stories.title: Pardoned turkeys to live full life at Colorado animal sanctuary
stories.summary: Four turkeys are spared from the Thanksgiving table by Gov. Polis and will enjoy a full life at a Colorado sanctuary.
